versions.changelog:
- Initial release: Extract text from images locally using Tesseract.js, with no API key required.
- Supports Chinese (simplified/traditional) and English language recognition.
- Offers command-line options for language selection and JSON/text output.
- Includes security guardrails: no remote fetching, no network transmission of output, and strict credential redaction.
- Language data is downloaded on first run and cached for efficiency.
